content.title: NYC Half Marathon 2026: Timing, route, street closures and more
content.text: Editor’s note: The above video previously aired on March 17, 2025. NEW YORK CITY (PIX11) — It’s time once again for thousands of runners to take the streets of New York City for the annual 2026 United Airlines NYC Half Marathon. As with previous years, more than 30,000 runners make their way from Brooklyn to Central Park in Manhattan in a 13.1-mile race. Below is everything to know about when the runners take to the streets and which areas to avoid if you’re trying to get around the city. What time does the NYC half-marathon start and end? The first wave of runners will take off at 7:20 a.m. on Sunday, with continued staggered start times until 8:30 a.m. The finish line will close around 1:30 p.m., about 4 hours and 30 minutes after the final participant crosses the start line. Where does the NYC half-marathon begin and end? The race will begin on Washington Avenue near the Brooklyn Museum and finish in Central Park near West 68th Street. How can I watch the half-marathon? The 2026 United Airlines NYC Half Marathon will be livestreamed starting at 7 a.m. on the New York Road Runners’ digital channels. New Yorkers who want to watch from the sidelines and cheer for the runners can join one of the cheer spots listed online. What is the route for the half marathon? After starting on Washington Avenue, runners will make their way through Prospect Park and across the East River via the Brooklyn Bridge. Once in Manhattan, runners will race along the FDR Drive to Midtown, and through Times Square before finishing in Central Park. A full course map can be found here. Close-up maps for the start line can be found here and for the finish line by clicking here. How can the half marathon runners be tracked? Runners can be tracked using the NYRR App during the event and on the NYRR website. What the street closures for the half marathon? A full list of street closures can be found by clicking here.
